name: What kind of warranties are available for a new roof?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranties are available for a new roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: New roofs typically come with two types of warranties: a material warranty from the manufacturer and a workmanship warranty from the contractor. Manufacturer warranties often range from 20 years to lifetime, depending on the product. Our workmanship warranty covers the installation for a specified period, ensuring quality and peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: New roofs typically have a material warranty from the manufacturer and a workmanship warranty from the contractor, covering different aspects of the roof.
